cost_scope: Rounded Lake frontend times of the final successful individual modules across incremental builds. Not a clean end-to-end time or a saving in the complete classical proof.

mathematical_scope.input: An injective D0092 graph homomorphism preserving all cyclic core turns, an ambient triangular rotation, and vertexwise cyclicity for the complete-star and reconstruction consumers.
mathematical_scope.generic_induced_rotation: First return constructs the rotation on the actual induced graph for an arbitrary retained vertex set and preserves vertexwise cyclicity.
mathematical_scope.ordered_boundary: Eleven source fan arcs supply the ordered distinct facial ring after deleting all seven core vertices; no ambient-size bound.
mathematical_scope.complete_stars: Every core row is closed under ambient rotation; vertexwise cyclicity excludes all additional ambient neighbours.
mathematical_scope.reconstruction: The existing planar seed-repair theorem now consumes the induced exterior directly; exterior coverage, complete core stars, exterior vertex cyclicity, facial boundary and port order are supplied. The same ambient colouring restricts to the selected exterior colouring.
mathematical_scope.exact_decrease: The existing exact-decrease theorem yields ambient vertex count = exterior vertex count + 7, with no introduced vertices.

finite_checks.example: A source cone supplies the complete core reading, triangular rotation and deletion boundary. It does not supply the seed colouring.

limitations: Exterior planarity and triangular remaining faces are still reconstruction hypotheses; they have not yet been derived uniformly from ambient planarity.
Full core-turn occurrence supply and remaining seed classes are open.
This is not full D0092 reducibility, a new unconditional strict reduction, or a coverage theorem.
No physical Kempe-switch history or switch-count bound is supplied.

required_dependencies: Existing compact seed repair and actual ambient reconstruction
